title: Zinda se reha hoke
body:
Zinda se reha hoke
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghum khaayegi zainab -  2
Mar jaayegi zainab - 2
Zindaan se reha hoke jo ghar jaayegi zainab
bin bhai ke jayegi to mar jayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghar lutgaya pardes may veeran hai dinya
zindan se reha hoke bhi zindan hai dunya
is qaid se ghar jaake bhi kya paaegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Soona hai makan jisme wo shehdayi na honge
ghar hoga magar ghar may mere bhai na honge
ta hashr yehi bhai ka gham khayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Bachpan hai jahan aun o mohamed ne guzaara
ab un dar o deewar ki tanhai ne maara
ab unke na saaye may khabi jayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Be aas mujhe kar gaye bache mere kamsin
bin beton ke kehlayi to kehlayi mai lekin
bin bhai ke dunya may na kehlayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Is baat pe hairat hai bahot ahle watan may
abbas se bhai ki bahan aur rasan may
roodad ye kis tarha se batlayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aaya na koi laut ke bhai tera sughra
soona hi rahega bani hashim ka mahella
kya deke dilaasay usay behlayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Haye roti hui jab jaaungi nana ki lehad par aur maajra poochegi wahan roohe payambar
kurta wo phata bhai ka dikhlayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aaya na hilal aisa kada waqt kisi par
kis kis ke liye royegi ye bekas o muztar
kis kis ka wahan fateha dilwayegi zainab
<<MINI>>
zindan se reha hoke....
